name: Lassonde Industries Inc.
summary: Lassonde Industries Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and markets a range of ready-to-drink beverages, fruit-based snacks, frozen juice concentrates, and specialty food products in Canada, the United States, and internationally.
